items.name: rn-adapter
items.title: RN Update Adapter
items.description: UpdateAdapter implementation for React Native / Expo Android: createRnAdapter (injectable downloader/installer/storage), delegating check to checkUpdateAndroid. Bundles ports + expo-installer (ACTION_VIEW + content URI, method A, zero native code) + expo-downloader (expo-file-system) + AsyncStorage KeyValueStorage.

items.name: update-texts
items.title: Update UI Texts
items.description: Framework-agnostic copy presets (en / zh-CN) for the RN update UI, including native-install-only keys (install / system-confirm hint / unknown-source hint / canceled). Override individual strings via props.

items.name: use-update
items.title: useUpdate
items.description: React hook reading the update engine from context, plus createSwarmHiveEngine() assembling rnAdapter + current versionCode (expo-application) + client_id (expo-crypto randomUUID).

items.name: release-notes-view
items.title: Release Notes View
items.description: Release notes renderer slot: renders Markdown by default via react-native-marked (headings/bold/lists/links/code), themed from NativeWind CSS variables. Overridable through the renderer prop. Background/box is provided by the parent dialog/section, mirroring the web registry.

items.name: update-provider
items.title: Update Provider
items.description: Async-assembles the update engine and provides it via context; optional check-on-mount and recheck-on-foreground (AppState 'change'->'active', backstop for the native install path).

items.name: prompt-update-dialog
items.title: Prompt Update Dialog
items.description: Optional update dialog built on React Native Reusables Dialog + Button + Progress + Text (NativeWind semantic tokens), mirroring the web registry: later / update-now actions, release notes, inline download progress, and a system-confirm hint while the installer is handing off. Requires a RNR PortalHost at the app root.

items.name: force-update-dialog
items.title: Force Update Dialog
items.description: Soft-forced update dialog built on React Native Reusables AlertDialog (no dismiss, no close X) + Progress + Text, shown when the server marks the release as a forced upgrade. 'Keep nagging' is backstopped by UpdateProvider's AppState recheck. Requires a RNR PortalHost at the app root.

items.name: update-progress-dialog
items.title: Update Progress Dialog
items.description: Standalone download-progress dialog built on React Native Reusables AlertDialog (non-dismissable) + Progress + Text, auto-shown while downloading / handing off to the system installer. Requires a RNR PortalHost at the app root.

items.name: update-settings-section
items.title: Update Settings Section
items.description: Settings-page section built on React Native Reusables Button + Progress + Text (NativeWind semantic tokens), mirroring the web registry: check / download / install buttons, status text, progress bar, system-confirm hint, and an error retry banner (border-destructive).
